prediction.raw: I would answer: 1 I think you are the asshole for lying to your boyfriend and letting him believe his ex cheated on him. While I understand that you wanted to help him move on and forget his ex, lying and manipulating his perception of the situation is not an acceptable way to achieve that goal. By lying, you've not only deceived your boyfriend, but you've also potentially damaged his ability to process his emotions and come to terms with the end of his previous relationship in a healthy way. You've also taken away his opportunity to work through his feelings and gain closure in an authentic manner. Furthermore, your motivations for lying seem to be largely self-serving.
